items.title: Marathon Petroleum Sinks 10%, Valero Down 8% as Oil Stocks Slide After Democrats Win the Senate
items.summary: Key TakeawaysMarathon Petroleum fell 10% today after Democrats won control of the Senate, and Valero, HF Sinclair and Phillips 66 fell with it. The selloff came a day after Marathon reported a huge third-quarter beat.

items.title: The 10-Year Treasury Yields 4.91%. These 4 Dividend Stocks Pay More
items.summary: The 10-year Treasury now hands you a nearly 5% yield with zero credit risk, so any dividend stock asking you to take on more complexity had better earn it. These four names do, and they come with something a government bond can never offer.

items.title: Marathon Petroleum (MPC) Agrees $4.2 Billion Refinery Deal To Refocus Its Footprint
items.summary: Marathon Petroleum (NYSE:MPC) agreed to sell its St. Paul Park and Mandan refineries and related assets to CVR Energy for US$4.2b. The transaction includes associated midstream and marketing operations that support the two upper Midwest refinery sites. The move reduces Marathon Petroleum's refining footprint in the northern U.S. while sharpening its focus on Gulf Coast operations. Marathon Petroleum's US$4.2b refinery sale to CVR Energy is only one piece of the wider story for this refiner...
